dati_metodo: Literature review (Annual Review of Financial Economics, 2021) of VC booms and start-up financing; no own data.

righe.estrazione: The paper is a review of the literature on VC booms and start-up financing. It covers three areas: drivers of VC inflows, real effects of booms on which firms are funded and on what terms, and concentration of VC by industry and geography, plus government policy.
righe.citazione: In this article, we review the nascent but growing literature that seeks to understand the relationship between VC booms and start-up financing.
righe.frase_paper: Janeway et al. (2021) review the literature on venture capital booms and start-up financing, covering the drivers of VC inflows, the real effects of booms and the concentration of VC by industry and geography.
righe.frase_slide: Review of the VC boom literature: inflows, real effects, concentration (Janeway et al., 2021)
righe.limiti_vs_noi: Review without own data; not specific to our 2012-2019 US PitchBook sample or to the gap between rounds.
righe.note: The tesi is a descriptive label (what the source is), which the txt supports as worded.
